name: Lupión (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, white and red, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Lupión (a castle on red and a tower and cross on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Lupión; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Lupión arms — castle on red, tower and cross on blue
